title: Role prompting: setting the role the model takes on

videos.script: Many prompts begin the same way. You are an expert. You are a senior engineer. You are a friendly barista. {{youare}} That opening line is a role, and it does change the answer. {{changes}} It changes the words the model reaches for, how formal it is, what it explains and what it takes for granted. {{register}} Ask the same question with two roles, and you get two different replies, both reasonable. {{two}} What a role cannot do is make an answer true. Calling the model an allergen expert gives it no new facts about your kitchen. {{expert}} It can make a wrong answer sound more certain. {{certain}} In this lesson you use roles for what they are good at, and put the facts somewhere else. {{facts}} And you meet the role that often matters most: not who the model is, but who it is talking to. {{audience}}
